desc: Derive the formula for the total number of monotone paths between all ordered pairs of lattice points in the full \([0,W]\times[0,H]\) grid.
Develop a counting method for paths intersecting the forbidden rectangle \([L,R]\times[D,U]\), accounting for arbitrary start and end points.
Check all degenerate cases: forbidden rectangle touching outer borders, zero width/height forbidden region, and paths of length zero.
Design an \(O(W+H)\) implementation using factorials, inverse factorials, and binomial coefficients.
Validate the derived method against public sample tests and ensure modulo arithmetic is handled correctly.
